qualifier: netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 cues
name: Netrin, SLIT-ROBO and ephrin axon guidance signaling
rationale: All members concern guidance-cue signaling steering axon extension and repulsion (netrin/DCC, SLIT-ROBO midline crossing, ephrin, L1/CHL1/DSCAM, RAC/CDC42 control), whereas confusables emphasize semaphorin-plexin, regeneration/sprouting or neuron-type-specific tract formation.

name: Regulation of respiratory burst and superoxide generation
rationale: All three members regulate the phagocyte oxidative burst producing superoxide, which none of the confusables (fungal lectin sensing, neutrophil degranulation, antimicrobial killing) contain.

name: Leptin-regulated appetite, feeding and body growth
rationale: Members cover leptin signaling, appetite, eating behavior, response to food and organism growth; leptin signaling and growth regulation separate it from ghrelin/prolactin and incretin-like feeding confusables.

qualifier: surface signature, positive chemotaxis and extravasation
name: Monocyte surface identity, activation and positive recruitment
rationale: Members describe monocyte surface/differentiation signatures, activation, aggregation and promotion of chemotaxis and extravasation, distinguishing it from generic myeloid modules and from confusables centered on negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage recruitment.

core: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover and cell migration
qualifier: epithelial and keratinocyte migration, wound spreading
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in epithelial and keratinocyte migration
rationale: Members regulate focal adhesion/matrix adhesion, Rac/Rho-driven protrusions, invadopodia and ECM disassembly together with epithelial, keratinocyte and wound-edge migration, which the CDC42 leading-edge and phosphatase-adhesion confusables lack.

core: Outflow tract and arch artery morphogenesis
name: Cardiac neural crest outflow tract and arch artery morphogenesis
rationale: All four members concern cardiac neural crest-dependent septation of the outflow tract and remodeling of pharyngeal arch and pulmonary arteries, unlike confusables on pharyngeal organs, endothelial specification or second heart field.

name: Dendritic spine maintenance with reelin and amyloid-beta signaling
rationale: Members concern maintenance of dendritic spines, projections and postsynaptic membrane under reelin signaling and amyloid-beta/tangle-related regulation, which distinguishes it from microglial pruning and plasticity-enhancing confusables.

qualifier: cAMP turnover plus phospholipase C-inositol phosphate arm
name: GPCR cAMP turnover and phospholipase C-inositol phosphate signaling
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and adenylate cyclase regulation together with PLC-coupled GPCR, IP3/phosphoinositide and calcium signaling (LPA receptors), whereas confusables center on PKA activation or adrenergic adenylate cyclase inhibition.

core: Cellular response to drugs and toxic chemicals
name: Responses to ethanol, anesthetics, drugs and toxicants
rationale: Members are responses to exogenous chemicals (ethanol, ether, anesthetics, nicotine, cisplatin, bleomycin, antibiotics, bisphenol A, hydroperoxide), which the oxidative-stress and UV confusables do not contain.

name: Lung branching growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members describe lung bud branching, lobe and vascular development and growth plus trachea formation and cartilage, the latter absent from surfactant/pneumocyte and mesenchymal-signaling confusables.

core: Presynaptic membrane potential and channel modulation
name: AMPA/kainate receptor activation and presynaptic G-protein channel modulation
rationale: Members combine ionotropic AMPA/kainate receptor activation with G-protein (GIRK, Gbeta-gamma calcium channel) control of presynaptic potential; the AMPA/kainate members are what the nicotinic, GABA and presynaptic-release confusables lack.

qualifier: class III RTK and FGFR1 fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic class III RTK and FGFR1 fusions and mutants
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by PDGFRA/B and FLT3 fusions or mutants plus cytosolic FGFR1 fusions, distinguishing it from FGFR2/3, ALK/LTK cancer signaling and normal FLT3 signaling confusables.

core: Regulation of plasma membrane sodium and potassium transport
name: Regulation of sodium export and potassium import
rationale: All three members regulate Na+ and K+ movement across the plasma membrane (Na/K exchange), whereas confusables cover pump mechanics, ion homeostasis, osmotic and calcium exchange.

qualifier: node of Ranvier and paranodal assembly
name: Myelination and node of Ranvier axon-glia organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses, axon caliber and neurofilaments, and nodal/paranodal assembly via neurofascin, NrCAM, L1-ankyrin and sodium channel clustering, which the regeneration and L1-signaling confusables lack.

name: Adiponectin regulation of glucose import and insulin sensitivity
rationale: Members concern adiponectin secretion and signaling with regulation of glucose import and insulin responsiveness, distinguishing it from GLUT4-translocation, insulin-receptor and fatty acid confusables.

name: Xenobiotic detoxification with ethanol and aldehyde oxidation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, toxin, mycotoxin and steroid metabolism with ethanol oxidation and aldehyde catabolism/detoxification, the latter missing from broader drug-metabolism confusables.

qualifier: Fc-gamma phagocytosis and B cell receptor
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members are activating immunoreceptor pathways for Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis and BCR second messenger/RAS signaling, versus confusables on Fc-epsilon/mast cells, inhibitory Fc signaling or CD22-mediated BCR regulation.

name: Aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion
rationale: All members concern mineralocorticoid (aldosterone) synthesis, metabolism regulation and secretion, while confusables cover responses to aldosterone, renal sodium handling and renin-angiotensin control.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 control of metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members describe APC/C-Cdc20 activity, its regulation and degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A at metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike spindle/cohesion confusables and APC/C-Cdh1 late mitosis confusables.

core: Phosphoregulation of p53 and G2/M progression
name: AKT-linked phosphoregulation of p53 turnover and G2/M progression
rationale: Members concern AKT target phosphorylation, p53 phosphorylation/degradation, Cdc25A turnover, CDK inhibition and MASTL/GTSE1 G2/M progression; AKT/PI3K members distinguish it from DNA damage checkpoint and p53 transcription confusables.

core: Feeding behavior and food intake regulation
name: Ghrelin-linked feeding behavior and nutrient-responsive food intake
rationale: Members cover eating behavior, ghrelin synthesis/secretion, prolactin secretion and food intake responses to nutrient levels, distinguishing it from the leptin-and-growth theme and orexin/sleep confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha response and antiviral ISG signatures (OAS, ISG15, IRF2 targets, IP-10), the effector side of IFN signaling, whereas confusables focus on RIG-I/TLR/STING-driven interferon induction and its regulation.

qualifier: gp130 receptors via STAT3 and ERK
name: IL-6 family gp130 cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members cover IL-6, IL-11, LIF and CNTF receptor signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation, distinguishing it from common-gamma-chain/STAT5 cytokine and erythropoietin/FLT3 confusables.

name: NGF processing and TRKA/p75NTR receptor signaling
rationale: Members concern NGF production and processing, its binding to TRKA and p75NTR, and proximal PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling, whereas confusables cover downstream TRK effector cascades, p75NTR death signaling or NTRK3.

core: Neurobehavior: motor, sensory and social behavior
name: MECP2 neuronal gene regulation and motor-sensory behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function pathways with locomotor, sensory, vocal, social and respiratory-control behaviors and glycinergic transmission (Rett-related phenotypes), which the synaptic transmission and hindbrain development confusables lack.
